entries.name: Syndicated finance
entries.definition: Raising money for a borrower through a group of lenders that share one loan under a single agreement, known as a syndicated loan.

entries.name: Synthesizing information
entries.definition: Combining information from several sources into one clear, coherent picture.

entries.name: Syskey
entries.definition: A legacy Windows utility that protected the account database with an extra startup key or password; Microsoft removed it in Windows 10 version 1709.

entries.name: Sysomos
entries.definition: A social media monitoring and analytics tool for tracking online conversations about brands, now part of Meltwater.

entries.name: System.Data
entries.definition: The .NET namespace that holds ADO.NET, the classes for connecting to databases and working with data.

entries.name: System implementation
entries.definition: Installing, configuring, testing and rolling out a new information system for an organisation.

entries.name: System recovery
entries.definition: Restoring a computer system to working order after a failure, for example from backups or recovery media.

entries.name: SystemJS
entries.definition: A JavaScript library that loads modules in the browser and in Node.js across several module formats.

entries.name: Systems management
entries.definition: Administering and monitoring an organisation's computer systems, including their configuration, performance, updates and support.

entries.name: Table data gateway
entries.definition: A design pattern in which one object acts as the gateway to a database table, holding all the SQL for reading and changing its rows.

entries.name: Table etiquette
entries.definition: Behaving politely at a dining table, including using cutlery correctly, serving and making conversation.

entries.name: Tableau
entries.definition: A data visualization and business-intelligence platform for exploring data and building interactive dashboards, owned by Salesforce.

entries.name: Tabular Data Stream
entries.definition: The application-layer network protocol that Microsoft SQL Server, and Sybase databases before it, use to talk to client programs.

entries.name: Taking messages
entries.definition: Recording messages from callers or visitors accurately and passing them on to the right person.

entries.name: Talent management
entries.definition: Attracting, developing and keeping the people an organisation needs, as a human-resources function.

entries.name: Tanium
entries.definition: An endpoint management and security platform that lets IT teams find, inspect and update large numbers of computers quickly.

entries.name: Tank truck
entries.definition: A truck that carries liquids or gases in a tank mounted on its frame.

entries.name: Tape measure
entries.definition: A flexible ruler, usually a metal or cloth tape wound into a case, used to measure length and distance.

entries.name: Tape recorder
entries.definition: A device that records and plays back sound on magnetic tape.

entries.name: Tax deduction
entries.definition: An expense or allowance that the tax rules let a person or business subtract from taxable income.

entries.name: Tax return
entries.definition: The form filed with a tax authority that reports income and other details and works out the tax owed or refunded.

entries.name: Tax shelter
entries.definition: A legal arrangement or investment that reduces the tax a person or business has to pay.

entries.name: Team leadership
entries.definition: Guiding, motivating and organising a group of people to complete shared work.

entries.name: Teamwork
entries.definition: Working cooperatively with colleagues to reach shared goals.

entries.name: Technical leadership
entries.definition: Guiding a team's technical direction and decisions and mentoring others, as a senior engineer or lead.

entries.name: Technical record-keeping
entries.definition: Keeping accurate, up-to-date records of technical work such as inspections, maintenance, tests and measurements.

entries.name: Technical theatre
entries.definition: The behind-the-scenes crafts of staging a production, such as lighting, sound, sets and stage management.

entries.name: Technical writing
entries.definition: Communicating technical information clearly in written form.

entries.name: Technology entrepreneurship
entries.definition: Starting and growing a business built on a new technology or technical product.

entries.name: Technology roadmap
entries.definition: A plan that sets out how technology will be developed or adopted over time to meet business goals.

entries.name: Tekla
entries.definition: Trimble's family of building information modelling software for structural design, detailing and construction, best known as Tekla Structures.

entries.name: Telecommunications equipment installation
entries.definition: Installing and connecting telecommunications equipment such as cabling, antennas, switches and phone systems.

entries.name: Telegraphy
entries.definition: Sending and receiving messages over a telegraph line or radio link, typically as Morse code.

entries.name: Telephone etiquette
entries.definition: Handling phone calls politely and professionally, including greeting callers, speaking clearly and ending calls well.

entries.name: Telescoping gauge
entries.definition: A T-shaped hand tool whose spring-loaded plungers expand to the width of a bore or slot so that the width can then be measured with a micrometer.

entries.name: Television programming
entries.definition: Choosing and scheduling the shows that a television channel broadcasts.

entries.name: Temporal.io
entries.definition: An open-source platform for running durable workflows, which keeps the state of long-running code so that it survives failures.

entries.name: TensorFlow
entries.definition: Building and executing machine-learning models with TensorFlow.

entries.name: Software testing
entries.definition: Designing checks and cases to evaluate software behavior.

entries.name: TestNG
entries.definition: A testing framework for Java, inspired by JUnit, that supports annotations, grouped and parallel tests and flexible test configuration.
